import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    MOD = 1000000007
    mat = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    sum_val = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        mat[i][0] = 1
        if (i + 0) % 2 == 1:
            sum_val = (sum_val + mat[i][0]) % MOD
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            mat[j][i] = (mat[j][i - 1] + mat[j - 1][i]) % MOD
            if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
                sum_val = (sum_val + mat[j][i]) % MOD
    print(sum_val)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
